content: Existence of attribute DiagnosticServiceInstance . ac- cessPermission Regarding the existence of the attribute DiagnosticService- Instance . accessPermission the following rules apply: • If neither the attribute DiagnosticServiceInstance . accessPermission or DiagnosticServiceClass . accessPermission exist it is assumed that the configuration is incomplete as no access permission is defined. • If either the attribute DiagnosticServiceInstance . accessPermission or DiagnosticServiceClass . accessPermission exists but does not have fur- ther references to DiagnosticSession , DiagnosticEnvironmentalCon- dition , or DiagnosticSecurityLevel then this means that the affected di- agnostic services can be executed in any diagnostic session or security level. In other words, no restriction applies.
